BEFORE THE FIRST VISIT

Common questions.

A few details that can help
you get started.

What residential work do you handle?+

Lighting, switches, outlets, dedicated circuits, panel upgrades, home EV charging, and troubleshooting. You can start with a small upgrade or describe a few items you’d like to address together.

Do you work with realtors preparing homes for sale?+

Yes. We can discuss repairs before listing, electrical items from a home inspection report, and work ahead of closing. Use the dedicated realtor inquiry to share the property, repair list, and target dates so we can review the scope and scheduling.

Where do you work?+

Power Ranger Electric is based in New Jersey. Include your town in your project details so we can confirm availability for your location.

Can we discuss a home EV charger?+

Yes. Share your vehicle or charger model if you have one, where you park, and what you’re hoping to install. We’ll review the existing electrical setup as part of planning the work.

How do I get an estimate?+

Start with a description of the work and your town. A conversation—and, when needed, a visit—helps define the scope before a project-specific estimate is prepared.

Do I need photos before reaching out?+

No. A description of the project is enough to begin. Photos of the area or existing equipment can be discussed later if they would help with planning.
